title: Leica M6 35mm Analog Rangefinder
purpose: Master reportage, documentary, and street photography with legendary German manual optics and classic silver halide grain.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Leica M6 Classic 35mm Rangefinder Film Camera
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Kodak Tri-X 400 silver halide film (or Kodak Portra 400)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 13 stops analog dynamic range with deep rich blacks and luminous highlights
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Rubberized cloth horizontal focal plane shutter, whisper-quiet 1/125s capture

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Unposed ambient street daylight, available natural light or moody tungsten streetlamp
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Authentic street documentary realism, deep emotional contrast, natural shadow roll-off

surface_rendering: True analog silver halide grain structure with tactile micro-acutance
Authentic skin texture: raw, honest, completely free of artificial smoothing or digital denoise artifacts
Leica micro-contrast: incredible punch and micro-texture on weathered surfaces, leather, and eyes
depth_and_optics: Classic German optical falloff: smooth three-dimensional subject isolation wide open
Subtle gentle spherical aberration and vintage glow in highlight areas
True optical perspective with zero digital distortion

execution_directive: Enforce authentic Leica M6 35mm analog street documentary character. Tangible silver halide film grain, Leica Summicron micro-contrast, honest unretouched human skin texture.
